desc: Implement invariant-based solution: compare ordered residues of 1s modulo X and ordered residues of 0s modulo Y, with special handling when X+Y>N.
Add normal-form computation and verification as a primary path, with invariant comparison as a safe fallback.
Run public sample tests; both passed.
Verify degenerate cases: X=1, Y=1, X+Y>N, empty one/zero sequences, and S==T.
